canonical_project: Moro Hub Green Data Centre at Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum Solar Park
notes: DEWA announced inauguration of the solar-powered data centre in 2023 and second phase in 2025; other DEWA material states full buildout target of 100MW. Located at MBR Solar Park in Saih Al-Dahal, mapped to Dubai Sector 9's southern non-urban/Al Marmoom area.
